notes: Tabs: open several PDFs at once, each in its own tab with its own unsaved changes, undo history and place in the document.
Closing a tab or Scalpel asks about every document with unsaved changes. Scalpel also reopens the tabs you had open.
New tab bar: drag to reorder, middle-click to close, right-click for more. Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9 jump between tabs.
Fixed: Scalpel could close with no warning while loading page thumbnails.
New tools: export pages as images, compare two PDFs, and measure distances.
